scope: Source-grounded stdlib and ordinary gxc stage products; proposed producer/consumer contract, not native implementation

sourceFacts.commonNativeBoundary: std/make gxc-compile and gxc-main both call compiler/driver compile-module; compile-scm-file reaches gsc-compile-file through direct or queued jobs.
sourceFacts.dynamicEnvironment: make-compile-job constructs the thread at enqueue time. Gambit macro-thread-init copies dynamic-local bindings from parent; delayed execution alone does not prove lost compiler parameters. Mutable payload alias closure is not certified.
sourceFacts.timestamp: One compile-module timestamp feeds emitted runtime binding and quoted uninterned symbol names through shared compile-symbol-table. It is a semantic payload, not a cache-only filename; same second is not a unique generation ID.
sourceFacts.dependencyReadiness: std/make posts completion after build/compile-module returns and drains queued GSC jobs after the entire graph. Metadata-ready is not native/macro-load-ready.
sourceFacts.reuseScope: Exact generated Scheme plus compiler/macro/context/native dependency closures. Skip source expansion only with an independently closed source-generation product; opaque callbacks force misses/refusal.
sourceFacts.resourceScope: RSS at stop motivates weighted reservation; it cannot calibrate an upper bound or justify a compiler memory budget.

timeout.note: Started jobs are not completed artifacts or phase durations.

targetContract.producer: PreparedSchemeProduct at compile-top-module after required runtime/meta/SSXI output closure; one original timestamp and binding projection shared across members
targetContract.nativeRequest: NativeCompileRequest under actual compiler parameter scope before add-compile-job!; seal argv/cwd/environment/role/source generation/provider and explicit output/naming policy
targetContract.nativeResult: Successful request-matching process and output manifest plus group drain, not start logs or surviving files
targetContract.readiness: Consumer-specific phi, runtime, static and ordered-link receipts; old std/make completion is not universal native readiness
targetContract.memory: parent reservation + active job credits <= total; unknown profile refuses, unknown completion retains credit/custody; actual-use bounds are independent premises

conditionalAccounting.scope: Retained-source BACH core phase only; not stdlib/packages and not measured acceleration
premises: No SCM restamping or binding change
No overlap/double credit to other mechanisms
